q1_issues.issue: The habitual verbal generic is packaged as one positive (And ...) event bundle carrying the 0.8 frequency strength, but a positive event is separate atoms and a verbal generic must be the distributing (Implication (Member $x fog) (And (Member (sk_cover $x) cover) ...)) rule of Quantifiers, generics & scope, which is where the frequency strength belongs.
The bare kind symbol fog fills the Agent slot of a single specific event witness sk_cover_1, so the parse asserts one particular covering event at strength 0.8 rather than the stated regularity.
The QuantifierPhrase companion names a range (fog / cover) that no rule in this parse quantifies, which the instruction set forbids ('never a range that appears nowhere else in the parse').

q2_gaps: Habitual with a frequency adverb over a bare MASS subject ('Fog usually covers the Hollows'): the instruction set calls a frequency adverb a quantifier over occasions but routes its strength onto an instance-ranging rule over the subject kind, and the only genuine occasion-domain machinery ('every time / whenever') requires a trigger clause, so there is no form that states 'on most occasions'.
notes: The Name-only treatment of the capitalized plural label 'the Hollows' (Name atom, no GroupOf, no invented type atom) is correct, as is the 0.8 dial for 'usually'.
